headline: Violent Frontline Shifts Sweep Coastal Islands and Central Midlands
war_summary: Combat across the midland and coastal sectors has intensified sharply over the past five hours, with violent base exchanges escalating in Tempest Island and Marban Hollow. Tempest Island witnessed eight strategic base changes in the latest two-hour window alone, contesting positions around The Gale and Reef, while Marban Hollow logged seven recent shifts around Maiden's Veil, Oster Wall, and The Spitrocks. Unrelenting friction persists in Endless Shore, which now records thirty-two base events over the day, centered on contested works at Woodbind, Wellchurch, and Saltbrook Channel. In the Drowned Vale, fighting remains brisk over The Wash and Eastmarch, tallying twenty total shifts. Concurrently, high-casualty engagements continue to test garrisons in Farranac Coast and Loch Mor, while heavy attrition in Dead Lands and Weathered Expanse mounts rapidly despite stabilizing perimeter lines. As enlistment surges cool relative to initial peak rates, both armies remain locked in stubborn contention across the primary operational corridors.
